name: Materials and chemistry data-task common pitfalls
description: Concrete, reusable fixes for recurring failures on materials/chemistry data and visualization tasks: phonon band/DOS units, charge-density difference cumulative integral, Papyrus filtering, QSAR target typing, refractive-index modeling, dataset column names, and library API misuse. Read before phonon, charge-density, band-gap, formation-energy, QSAR, ligand/protein fingerprint, or property-prediction tasks.
